description: This file implements a calculation engine for mathematical derivatives, integrals, and limits, utilizing the mathjs library. It exports an async function `calculate` that processes different types of mathematical computations based on provided options, including symbolical differentiation, integration, and limit evaluation, with support for intermediate steps and error handling.
